description: Resolve web-app URLs — for records, a database, and/or its saved views — without a round-trip per record. get_record / query_records / create_record / update_record already include a `url` on each record; this tool returns a database link, a view link, or a batch of record links in one call.

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id. Required to resolve `records` or `views`; on its own, returns just the database link.

records.description: Record uuids or public numbers to link.

views.description: View names or ids to link.

name: get_links
title: Get links
